research_rationale:
EO 10169 (October 11, 1950, Harry S. Truman), read in full in the held Federal Register text and the held Federal Register text, establishes the National Advisory Committee on Mobilization Policy to advise the National Security Resources Board (section 1), has the Board's Chairman appoint its members from business, labor, agriculture and the public (section 2), requests agencies to cooperate (section 3) and makes the Board defray expenses (section 4). The order has no stated term. EO 10480 (August 14, 1953), held Federal Register text, lists it in section 607 among orders "superseded or revoked". That is the first end for every section.

savings.reason: EO 10480 section 606 keeps in effect orders, regulations and other actions relating to functions it affects, except as inconsistent with it, and states that nothing in it affects the validity of anything done under earlier delegations. Section 606 concerns actions taken under functions, not the Committee; no held source shows that the Committee, its membership or its expenses continued after August 14, 1953. That is a disclosed qualification, not a finding.
